title: Doubled hour on the autumn clock change
summary: A unique test failed downstream of ing_events; exp_bi_dashboards was stale for 9 hours.
root_cause: On 2024-10-27 local hour 02 happened twice. ing_events raised AmbiguousTimeError warnings and wrote the hour twice, so keys were duplicated.
resolution: Removed the doubled hour and reran.
follow_ups: Local time only for display.

title: Expired credential stopped src_shop_db
summary: mart_customer_ltv was stale for 4 hours.
root_cause: The credential src_shop_db uses for shopdb-replica.internal expired. Every run failed within seconds with an authentication error (401 Unauthorized).
resolution: Rotated the credential and restarted src_shop_db.
follow_ups: Expiry dates are tracked and rotated 14 days ahead.

title: sftp.finance.example could not be resolved
summary: exp_finance_ledger was stale for 2 hours.
root_cause: After a DNS change, sftp.finance.example returned NXDOMAIN from the resolver. Every run of exp_finance_ledger failed before connecting.
resolution: Restored the DNS record and reran exp_finance_ledger.
follow_ups: Monitor name resolution of external hosts.

title: Files loaded twice by ing_payments
summary: exp_crm_segments failed for 7 hours after a unique test failure.
root_cause: The same landing file was loaded twice by ing_payments; the test unique payment_id failed downstream.
resolution: Deleted the second copy and reran.
follow_ups: Checksums of loaded files are recorded.

title: Retry storm on src_payments_api
summary: mart_customer_ltv was late for 8 hours.
root_cause: A higher retry count made src_payments_api use up the hourly quota of api.payments.example faster; every call then got HTTP 429.
resolution: Restored the retry setting and reran src_payments_api.
follow_ups: Retries now back off and respect Retry-After.

title: Config deploy broke fct_marketing_spend
summary: mart_marketing_roi failed for 3 hours.
root_cause: A config deploy set incremental_key to updated. fct_marketing_spend failed at start-up with a config error on every run after the deploy.
resolution: Rolled back to the previous config version and reran.
follow_ups: Configs are validated in CI before deploy.

title: Clock change broke fct_sessions
summary: exp_bi_dashboards stopped updating on the clock-change night, for 3 hours.
root_cause: fct_sessions builds hourly partitions in local time (Europe/Berlin). On 2025-03-30 local hour 02 did not exist and the job failed with NonExistentTimeError.
resolution: Rebuilt the day in UTC and reran downstream.
follow_ups: Partitions are now built in UTC.

title: Name resolution failures on exp_finance_ledger
summary: exp_finance_ledger received no data for 9 hours.
root_cause: DNS lookups for sftp.finance.example timed out and then failed with Temporary failure in name resolution.
resolution: Pointed the workers back to the old resolver and reran.
follow_ups: Resolver changes go through change review.

title: Exit code 137 on fct_sessions
summary: exp_bi_dashboards was stale for 9 hours.
root_cause: A sale doubled the input of fct_sessions. Memory reached the limit and the task failed with exit code 137 after running twice as long as usual.
resolution: Processed the input in smaller batches and reran.
follow_ups: Limits sized for peak volume.

title: Invalid timezone in mart_daily_revenue.yaml
summary: exp_bi_dashboards was stale for 9 hours.
root_cause: A new config version of mart_daily_revenue had an invalid timezone; runs failed within seconds of loading it.
resolution: Rolled back, fixed the value in review and redeployed.
follow_ups: Config schema check in CI.

title: Memory leak in dim_customers
summary: exp_crm_segments received no data for 6 hours.
root_cause: Memory of dim_customers climbed towards the limit run after run until the container was OOMKilled (exit code 137).
resolution: Restarted with a higher limit, then fixed the leak.
follow_ups: Track peak memory per run.

title: Renamed field broke ing_crm_contacts
summary: mart_customer_ltv was stale for 2 hours and its freshness alert fired.
root_cause: The CRM vendor renamed the field email to email_address. ing_crm_contacts failed its data contract on every batch and quarantined it, so nothing reached the warehouse.
resolution: Updated the contract and the mapping, released the quarantined batches and reran ing_crm_contacts.
follow_ups: Subscribed to the source's change notices.

title: Certificate expiry on exp_finance_ledger
summary: exp_finance_ledger did not receive data for 4 hours.
root_cause: A client certificate used by exp_finance_ledger expired; the TLS handshake with sftp.finance.example failed on every run.
resolution: Issued a new certificate and reran the failed runs.
follow_ups: Alert on expiry warnings.

title: HTTP 429 from api.payments.example after a quota cut
summary: mart_daily_revenue received partial data for 8 hours.
root_cause: The provider lowered the hourly quota. src_payments_api hit HTTP 429 Too Many Requests every hour, and its run time grew with the Retry-After waits.
resolution: Asked the provider to restore the quota and spread the requests over the hour.
follow_ups: Alert when quota use passes 80%.

title: Duplicate event_id values after a consumer restart
summary: A unique test failed downstream of ing_events; mart_marketing_roi stopped updating for 8 hours.
root_cause: A consumer of ing_events restarted from an old offset and replayed messages, so ing_events loaded rows twice. The unique test on event_id failed further down.
resolution: Removed the duplicates at ing_events and reran downstream.
follow_ups: Loads are now idempotent with a key-based merge.

title: api.ads.example quota used up by a backfill
summary: mart_marketing_roi missed its freshness SLA by 5 hours.
root_cause: A backfill shared the API key of src_ads_api. The API answered HTTP 429 Too Many Requests and src_ads_api gave up after 5 attempts on each page.
resolution: Paused the backfill, waited for the quota to reset and reran src_ads_api.
follow_ups: Backfills now use their own API key and run at night.

title: Rollback of stg_customers config
summary: mart_daily_revenue failed its freshness check for 8 hours.
root_cause: The first run after a config deploy of stg_customers failed with a config error: partition_column = 'order_dt'.
resolution: Rolled back the deploy and reran the failed runs.
follow_ups: Deploys of production configs need a second reviewer.

title: Contract violation on ing_orders after a source release
summary: Row counts of exp_bi_dashboards dropped to zero for 3 hours.
root_cause: A source release replaced total_amount with order_total. The data contract of ing_orders rejected every record: required field missing.
resolution: Mapped the new field, reran ing_orders and backfilled the missing hours.
follow_ups: Contract tests now run against the source sandbox before each release.

title: Report not ready for src_ads_api
summary: mart_marketing_roi freshness alert fired after 3 hours.
root_cause: The provider published its report late. src_ads_api logged that the report was not ready and wrote 0 rows.
resolution: Reran src_ads_api once the report was published.
follow_ups: Retry the report until it is ready, with a clear warning.

title: Late files from sftp.logistics-partner.example
summary: exp_bi_dashboards row counts dropped to zero for 4 hours; no pipeline failed.
root_cause: The provider delivered the files hours late. src_partner_sftp found no file and finished with 0 rows, so every downstream pipeline ran on stale data.
resolution: Waited for the files, reran src_partner_sftp and backfilled the missing hours.
follow_ups: Freshness check on the source itself.

title: No space left on device on ing_orders
summary: exp_bi_dashboards failed its freshness check for 3 hours.
root_cause: Temporary files from a backfill filled /mnt/work/ing_orders. Writes failed with OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device.
resolution: Deleted the temporary files and reran the failed runs.
follow_ups: Temporary files are now cleaned at the end of every run; disk alert at 85%.

title: Replica lag behind src_shop_db
summary: exp_finance_ledger showed partial data for 5 hours.
root_cause: The source lagged by hours. src_shop_db extracted only up to its watermark and wrote few rows; no run failed.
resolution: Waited for the source to catch up and backfilled.
follow_ups: Lag alert at 30 minutes.

title: Work volume of ing_events full
summary: mart_marketing_roi showed no new data for 8 hours.
root_cause: Disk use on /mnt/work/ing_events grew for days and reached 100%; every run then failed with No space left on device.
resolution: Extended the volume and reran ing_events.
follow_ups: Weekly review of volume growth.

title: Merge matched customers twice in stg_customers
summary: exp_finance_ledger was stale for 9 hours.
root_cause: A merge in stg_customers matched some records twice, so customer_id values were duplicated and a unique test failed downstream.
resolution: Fixed the merge condition and rebuilt the table.
follow_ups: Duplicate test at the pipeline itself.

title: dim_customers OOMKilled after an input surge
summary: mart_daily_revenue missed its freshness SLA by 5 hours.
root_cause: Rows read by dim_customers tripled during a backfill. The container was OOMKilled (exit code 137) on every run.
resolution: Raised the memory limit to 32 GiB and split the input into batches.
follow_ups: Memory alert at 85% of the limit.
